direct_observations: DatasetAdmission cross-binds transition/prototype/training references to one vector_control_packet_sha256 and cross-binds one vector_control_condition.
DatasetAdmission checks the training/transition ABI label equals JSPACE_VECTOR_CONTROL_ABI/v1.
DatasetAdmission has no admitted_vector_control_packets input and does not call jspace_vector_control_v1.validate_packet on an exact packet preimage.

The positive DatasetAdmission unit fixture uses an arbitrary synthetic control_packet_sha equal to 64 repeated '5' hex characters and admits it without constructing or validating a VectorControlPacket.
Therefore cross-layer digest equality proves agreement on a label/digest but does not prove that the digest names an admitted, canonical, semantically valid JSPACE_VECTOR_CONTROL_ABI/v1 packet.
observed_source_gap.epistemic_boundary: SOURCE_DIRECT; no runtime or unusual intervention required to establish the missing admission edge

hypothesis: A collusively self-consistent training/transition/prototype family can carry the same syntactically valid but nonexistent or invalid vector-control digest through DatasetAdmission because packet preimage admission is not independently required.
counterhypothesis: Cross-layer equality of the vector-control digest plus ABI string is sufficient because one of the admitted trace registries already proves the packet semantics.
counterhypothesis_rejection: The inspected gate registries contain training, transition, prototype and GRID evidence only; none supplies or validates the VectorControlPacket preimage. The positive test fixture demonstrates admission with an arbitrary digest and no packet object.

minimal_fail_closed_patch_contract.authority: extend the existing single DatasetAdmission path; do not create a second dataset or vector-control authority
minimal_fail_closed_patch_contract.required_input: caller-owned admitted_vector_control_packets registry keyed by exact packet.packet_sha256
required_checks: referenced vector_control_packet_sha256 must exist in admitted_vector_control_packets
registry key must equal the exact packet.packet_sha256
packet.generation must equal the cross-bound training/transition/prototype generation
packet.basis_id must equal the cross-bound J-Space basis id
packet.basis_sha256 must equal the cross-bound J-Space basis digest
packet.role must equal the cross-bound role
packet.control_condition must equal the cross-bound vector-control condition
missing, malformed, tampered, stale-generation, wrong-basis, wrong-role or wrong-condition packet evidence must fail closed

required_regressions: shared arbitrary digest with no packet preimage is rejected
valid admitted packet with exact generation/basis/role/condition passes
registry-key versus packet_sha256 mismatch is rejected
tampered/self-inconsistent packet is rejected by validate_packet
basis id or basis digest transplant is rejected
